name: take_screenshot_with_grid
description:
Captures a desktop screenshot with a labeled coordinate grid overlay (rulers & crosshairs).
Allows instant, zero-guesswork visual reading of exact pixel coordinates when inspecting with view_file.

filename.description: Optional filename to save as. Defaults to 'desktop_grid.png'.

step.description: Grid line spacing in pixels (e.g. 50 or 100). Default is 100.
